admission.justification: Prevents a retry borrowing foreign-provider permission choices or selecting an unconfigured stronger execution.

applicability: Role starts with a user-configured single step-up alternative, selected by failed-review threshold or a reasoned explicit request.
conditions: Worker counts failing recorded code rounds and Curator counts failing recorded memory rounds; record-only checks add no try and other roles are on-request.
Validate selected alternatives against offered host choices before retirement; do not inherit permission/mode/features from a different provider/model scope.
Explicit same-start agent/model/effort retain fieldwise precedence.
exclusions: No caller mode or permission-feature authority.
No automatic step-up with absent/unknown counts or absent configuration, no nested alternative and no reset of review allowance.
statement: The product selects user-authored step-up choices from persisted failed-review counts or an explicit reason while explicit same-start agent, model and effort overrides retain fieldwise precedence.
